home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): muda wa kusubiri kuchukua kwa madereva wa usafirishaji nchini Uingereza

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Ona madereva husubiri muda gani kwenye mikahawa na maduka kabla hujaingia. Kwa madereva wa Uber Eats, Deliveroo na Just Eat nchini Uingereza. Huhitaji kujisajili.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Jua muda wa kusubiri kabla hujaingia.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Unasafirisha kwa Uber Eats, Deliveroo au Just Eat? Ona muda wa kusubiri wa hivi karibuni kwenye sehemu za kuchukua za mikahawa na maduka. Epuka kusubiri kwa muda mrefu. Gusa {reportWait} upate {radarPoints}. Huhitaji kujisajili.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Sasa iko Milton Keynes. Inayofuata ni London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Programu za iPhone na Android zinakuja hivi karibuni.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Mfano wa skrini ya Mwanzo ya PickupRadar ikiwa kichupo {nearby} kimefunguliwa, sehemu za kuchukua zikiwa na rangi kulingana na muda wa kusubiri

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Skrini ya mfano: muda wa kusubiri wa sampuli, si ripoti za moja kwa moja za madereva

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Skrini ya mfano. Hivi ni muda wa kusubiri wa sampuli, si ripoti za moja kwa moja. {live} kwa data halisi.

home.example.live.text: Jaribu onyesho la moja kwa moja

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Tumia {nearby} kupata sehemu za kuchukua karibu nawe eneo likiwa limewashwa. Tumia {fast} na {slow} kuangalia muda wa kusubiri na makadirio.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Jaribu jina, eneo au msimbo wa posta, kama KFC au Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Skrini ya {reportWait} inafunguka. Chagua muda wa kusubiri. Hakuna kinachotumwa.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Unaona lebo zilezile kwenye programu. Madereva huziripoti, si programu za usafirishaji.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Madereva huchagua muda wa kusubiri. Unaona muda wa kusubiri sasa na madereva wangapi waliuripoti katika saa 2 zilizopita.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Huonyeshwa tu wakati hakuna ripoti za hivi karibuni. Haya ni makadirio, si ripoti za moja kwa moja.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Madereva hugusa {reportProblem} kuripoti hili. Unaona ripoti yao kabla hujaenda huko.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Sehemu za kuchukua zinazokosekana au zisizo sahihi

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Hatua tatu rahisi. Kuripoti huchukua sekunde chache.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Hakuna nenosiri. Programu hukupa wasifu wa Radar kiotomatiki. Huhitaji kujisajili.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Tafuta sehemu ya kuchukua. Ona muda wa kusubiri sasa, au {likelyFast} au {likelySlow} ikiwa hakuna ripoti za hivi karibuni.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Baada ya kuchukua oda, gusa {reportWait}. Huchukua sekunde. Ripoti yako huwasaidia madereva wengine, na unapata {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Sehemu ya kuchukua inayostahili karibu nawe, bila muda wa kusubiri wa hivi karibuni na bila {likelyFast} wala {likelySlow}. Unapata 15 RP kwa ripoti hiyo badala ya 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Hizi ni miji ya Uingereza kwenye programu. Huioni mji wako? Uombe kwenye programu. Au gusa {notify} kwenye mji {comingSoon}. Tutakutumia barua pepe utakapoanza.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Si sehemu ya programu yoyote ya usafirishaji

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar ni huru. Si sehemu ya Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat wala programu nyingine yoyote ya usafirishaji. Haitumii akaunti zako huko.

home.trust.loginLead.text: Hakuna kuingia kwenye programu za usafirishaji.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Hatuombi jina la mtumiaji wala nenosiri la Uber Eats, Deliveroo au Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Hakuna maelezo ya mteja au oda.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Hakuna majina, anwani wala nambari za oda.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Hapana. Programu hukupa wasifu wa Radar kiotomatiki. Unaweza kuripoti muda wa kusubiri mara moja. Ili kulinda {radarPoints}, ongeza barua pepe baadaye. Hakuna nenosiri. Programu inakutumia msimbo wa tarakimu 6 kwa barua pepe.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Programu za iPhone na Android zinakuja hivi karibuni. Kwa sasa, {preview} inaonyesha sehemu halisi za kuchukua na muda wa kusubiri huko Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Hakuna ufuatiliaji wa chinichini. Programu hutumia eneo lako unapoitumia, kuonyesha sehemu za kuchukua zilizo karibu na kuthibitisha uko kwenye sehemu ya kuchukua unaporipoti. Tovuti huomba eneo tu unapochagua kulitumia. Soma {privacy} kwa maelezo zaidi.

home.closer.cta.text: Fungua onyesho la moja kwa moja

app.meta.title.text: Onyesho la moja kwa moja la programu — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Jaribu programu ya PickupRadar kwa data halisi ya Milton Keynes. Angalia, tafuta sehemu za kuchukua na uone skrini ya ripoti.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Hii ni PickupRadar yenye data halisi ya Milton Keynes. Angalia. Tafuta sehemu ya kuchukua uifungue. Hakuna unachogusa hapa kinachotumwa. Unaweza kuripoti kwenye programu ya simu pekee.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Onyesho kamili la programu ya PickupRadar lenye data halisi ya Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Msaada wa PickupRadar: wasiliana na usaidizi, ripoti tatizo la sehemu ya kuchukua, na upate majibu kuhusu wasifu wa Radar, {radarPoints} na kufuta akaunti.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Unahitaji msaada? Tutumie barua pepe kuhusu programu, sehemu ya kuchukua, {radarPoints} au faragha yako.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Tutumie barua pepe kwa msaada, mawazo, matatizo ya sehemu za kuchukua au maswali ya faragha:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Kwa barua tu. Barua pepe ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kutufikia.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Eneo au msimbo wa posta, ukiujua

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Aina ya simu, ikiwa tatizo liko kwenye programu

support.topics.profile.title.text: Wasifu wa Radar na barua pepe

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Programu hukupa wasifu wa Radar kiotomatiki. Huhitaji kuingia ili kutumia PickupRadar au kupata {radarPoints}. Kuongeza barua pepe ni hiari. Inalinda {radarPoints} ukibadilisha au kuweka upya simu. Hakuna nenosiri. Programu inakutumia msimbo wa tarakimu 6 kwa barua pepe.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Unapata {radarPoints} kwa ripoti halali za muda wa kusubiri ({waitRp}, au {neededRp} inaposema {reportNeeded}), bonasi ya ripoti ya kwanza ({firstRp}) na sehemu za kuchukua tunazoidhinisha ({approvedRp}). Unaweza kumwalika dereva kutoka {profile}. Nyote mnahitaji akaunti za Radar zilizolindwa (ongeza barua pepe). Rafiki yako anaingiza msimbo wako kabla ya ripoti yake ya kwanza halali ya muda wa kusubiri. Rafiki yako anapofanya ripoti 3 halali za muda wa kusubiri, kwa angalau siku 2 tofauti (saa za UTC), katika sehemu 2 tofauti za kuchukua, kila mmoja anapata {referralRp}. {rewards} Bado huwezi kukomboa {radarPoints}.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} ina {messages}: matangazo, arifa na ujumbe binafsi kwa mji wako au wasifu wa Radar. Ujumbe wa zamani au ulioondolewa unaweza usionekane tena.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Futa akaunti kwenye programu: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Au tumia barua pepe kwa {email}. Ikiwa hukutia barua pepe, programu inaonyesha {deleteProfile}. Ona ukurasa wa {page} kwa hatua.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Sehemu ya kuchukua haipo? Gusa {suggest} kwenye programu. Moja si sahihi? Gusa {reportProblem}. Au tutumie barua pepe tutaangalia.

support.topics.delivery.title.text: Akaunti zako za programu za usafirishaji

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar haiunganishi na akaunti zako za Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat au programu nyingine za usafirishaji. Hatuombi kuingia, manenosiri, maelezo ya akaunti, maelezo ya wateja wala maelezo ya oda. Madereva hushiriki ripoti za kuchukua tu, kama muda wa kusubiri na matatizo ya sehemu za kuchukua.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Onyesho la moja kwa moja linaonyesha sehemu halisi za kuchukua na muda wa kusubiri huko Milton Keynes. Kuripoti na {radarPoints} viko kwenye programu ya simu pekee.
